dd5966faef48.title_en: Richemont reports strong profitability in the first half
dd5966faef48.summary: Luxury group Richemont has announced robust profitability figures for its first fiscal semester. The results highlight strong resilience across its core maisons.

f7179c19f818.title_en: Primark Sustainability Report 2026: 81 percent sustainable fibres
f7179c19f818.summary: Primark states that 81 percent of its clothing is now made from recycled or more sustainably sourced fibres. This marks an increase from 74 percent the previous year, according to its fifth annual Sustainability and Ethics Progress Report.

e1d8d51931ab.title_en: Regatta taps former JD Sports marketer as marketing director
e1d8d51931ab.summary: Regatta has appointed former JD Sports Fashion marketing executive Emma Harnett as its marketing director starting in October. Harnett oversees the international teams and the launch of the new autumn/winter campaign.

2c543b2c074b.title_en: FREE THE YOUTH Unveils Friends & Family Exclusive Air Jordan 16 Evoking EVA Unit-01
2c543b2c074b.summary: Ghana-based creative collective FREE THE YOUTH has revealed a Friends & Family exclusive Air Jordan 16. The shoe features a purple and green color scheme inspired by Neon Genesis Evangelion.

0874cead194d.title_en: Airplum slippers open their first boutique focusing on their own brand
0874cead194d.summary: Slipper brand Airplum has opened its first standalone retail boutique. The company is shifting focus toward expanding its proprietary brand presence.

3708f8091c61.title_en: Mulberry opens new store in Liverpool One
3708f8091c61.summary: British luxury brand Mulberry has expanded its retail footprint with the opening of a new store in Liverpool One. The location showcases the latest collections and brand concepts.

49d19561ba7b.title_en: Drapers Reports from Oxford Street on Black Friday
49d19561ba7b.summary: Drapers covers retail activity on Oxford Street during the Black Friday shopping event. The publication examines store performance and consumer traffic trends in London.

393662bf60e7.title_en: Temu Commits to End Fake Discounts, Pressure Selling and Forced Gamification, EU Says
393662bf60e7.summary: The European Union announced that Temu has committed to eliminating fake discounts, pressure selling tactics, and forced gamification on its platform. This regulatory action targets unfair e-commerce practices affecting European consumers.

b620ccfe7e7e.title_en: JP Morgan Reviews Luxury Sector and Revises Opinions on Adidas and Puma
b620ccfe7e7e.summary: JP Morgan has published a review of the luxury sector while updating its analyst recommendations for Adidas and Puma across Europe. The financial assessment provides new perspectives on these major apparel and luxury players.

6950c7b5b064.title_en: Poundstretcher Owner Considering Sale After Poundland Collapse
6950c7b5b064.summary: The owner of Poundstretcher is considering a sale following the collapse of rival retailer Poundland. The retail sector continues to experience strategic shifts and ownership changes.

45b088fb3f28.title_en: Regatta Appoints New Marketing Director to Drive Next Phase of Growth
45b088fb3f28.summary: Regatta Group has appointed Emma Harnett as its new Marketing Director to lead the next phase of growth. The company manages outdoor apparel brands including Regatta Great Outdoors, Craghoppers, Dare 2b, and Regatta Professional.

c8627ae8e3a8.title_en: Vietnam Expects to Sign US Trade Deal to Limit Tariff Hit
c8627ae8e3a8.summary: Vietnam anticipates signing a trade agreement with the United States to mitigate potential tariff impacts. The deal holds significant implications for manufacturing and sourcing operations in the region.

22a00762a5ce.title_en: Nike Opens First-Ever Running Store on Shanghai's Xinle Road
22a00762a5ce.summary: Nike has opened its first dedicated running store on Shanghai's Xinle Road in a community-focused two-story space. The location features exclusive products designed for the upcoming Shanghai Marathon.

ce7eedff5318.title_en: Swedish Textile Service Association autumn meeting focuses on industry challenges and opportunities
ce7eedff5318.summary: The Swedish Textile Service Association held its autumn meeting on November 12. The event brought together industry professionals for discussions on sector challenges and opportunities.

86dec7aadeb5.title_en: Debenhams CEO discusses how AI is reshaping Black Friday and Christmas shopping
86dec7aadeb5.summary: Debenhams CEO Dan shares insights in a Q&A format on the impact of artificial intelligence on holiday shopping. The discussion highlights how AI is reshaping strategies for Black Friday and Christmas sales.

8beb49cdc25f.title_en: K-Way appoints former The North Face executive as new Chief Product Officer
8beb49cdc25f.summary: K-Way has appointed Edouard Gros as its new Chief Product Officer. The executive joins to drive the brand's next phase of growth.

58f4f9fd8515.title_en: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed due to weather for first time in 100 years
58f4f9fd8515.summary: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed due to weather conditions. This marks the first time in 100 years that the event has been delayed.

eecddc6224d3.title_en: LVMH: Bernard Arnault allowed to head family holding until age 95
eecddc6224d3.summary: LVMH chief Bernard Arnault is permitted to remain at the head of the family holding company until the age of 95. This governance decision secures the long-term leadership structure of the luxury group.

876e57a765c0.title_en: Christie's puts Alexander McQueen Plato's Atlantis Dress up for auction
876e57a765c0.summary: Christie's New York is putting an iconic dress from the late designer Alexander McQueen's final full collection up for online auction. The sale will run from 25 November to 10 December.

1375013e1cf2.title_en: Poundland collapses into administration with 11,000 jobs at risk
1375013e1cf2.summary: Owner Gordon Brothers has reportedly been told it has no choice but to file for insolvency after a second notice period passed without a solvent deal. Up to 12,000 jobs and around 600 stores are at stake.

ecceaf3d9aeb.title_en: John Lewis unveils first phase of Glasgow flagship transformation with menswear at forefront
ecceaf3d9aeb.summary: John Lewis has unveiled the first phase of its £23 million Glasgow flagship store transformation. The project marks the company's largest single-store investment in over five years.

16c150691d17.title_en: Urban Outfitters delivers record third-quarter sales as net income rises 15%
16c150691d17.summary: Urban Outfitters posted record third-quarter sales alongside a 15% increase in net income. Growth was supported by strong performances from FP Movement and clothing rental service Nuuly.

000cdb1a4047.title_en: Shein's European revenue falls after EU introduces parcel duty
000cdb1a4047.summary: Shein's European revenue declined following the introduction of a new EU parcel duty. Meanwhile, group operating income rose 17% as the company raised prices and cut marketing spend by over 40%.

7b24accfdde2.title_en: Victoria's Secret names Edgewell CEO Rod Little as next Chair
7b24accfdde2.summary: Donna James, chair since the 2021 spin-off from L Brands, will retire from the board at the 2027 annual meeting. Her departure follows months after she survived an activist push to unseat her.

c049c7a983cb.title_en: TK Maxx to open at Bluewater next year
c049c7a983cb.summary: Off-price retailer TK Maxx is scheduled to open a new location at the Bluewater shopping center next year. The addition expands the center's retail assortment.

b861fd89742b.title_en: Ralph Lauren Home Store Opens in Milan
b861fd89742b.summary: Ralph Lauren has opened a new Home store in Milan. The new location showcases the brand's interior collections alongside its luxury aesthetic.

1ebcc725838e.title_en: India-US trade deal near completion after Trump tariff threat
1ebcc725838e.summary: An India-US trade deal is nearing completion following previous tariff threats from Trump. The agreement is set to impact international commerce between the two regions.

6ccee13a8e2d.title_en: Cribbs mall in dual leadership changes
6ccee13a8e2d.summary: Cribbs mall has announced dual leadership changes. The adjustments aim to guide the retail destination through its next phase.

6f3055685bc5.title_en: Retail can turn customers into suppliers as closet clearouts power resale growth, report says
6f3055685bc5.summary: A new industry report highlights that fashion retailers can transform customers into suppliers through closet clearouts. This trend is currently powering significant growth in the resale market.

9adcd80a3c75.title_en: Debenhams and JD Sports partner with Meta for the UK launch of its Muse AI agent
9adcd80a3c75.summary: Retailers Debenhams and JD Sports have partnered as launch brands for the rollout of Meta's Muse AI agent in the United Kingdom. The new AI tool aims to enhance customer engagement and shopping experiences across digital platforms.

1eec87f2d55c.title_en: Next supplier impacted by a cyberattack
1eec87f2d55c.summary: British fashion and homewares retailer Next has reported that one of its suppliers has been hit by a cyberattack. Operations and supply chain communications may experience temporary disruptions as the situation is handled.

b61837ab6284.title_en: UK's Black Friday week to see small dip says IMRG
b61837ab6284.summary: IMRG forecasts a small dip in sales for the upcoming Black Friday week in the UK. The retail industry monitors these figures closely to gauge consumer spending trends.

c9ed28363875.title_en: Dior names Stray Kids' Hyunjin new ambassador as Rihanna returns with her daughter
c9ed28363875.summary: Dior has appointed Stray Kids member Hyunjin as its new brand ambassador. Meanwhile, Rihanna makes a return alongside her daughter for the luxury house.

01b23add7fc2.title_en: The RealReal opens third Los Angeles-area store
01b23add7fc2.summary: Consignment platform The RealReal has expanded its physical retail footprint by opening its third store in the Los Angeles area. This opening highlights the continuous growth of the secondhand luxury market.

738373f7df8f.title_en: Birkenstock opens first stores in Greece
738373f7df8f.summary: Footwear brand Birkenstock has launched its first official retail locations in Greece. The expansion marks another step in the brand's direct-to-consumer retail strategy.
